meta.title: Our story: why Colombian Coffee Origins exists
meta.description: We connect Colombian family coffee farms, starting in Urrao, Antioquia, with roasters and importers. Learn why we exist and how we work with producers.

banner.title: Our
banner.description: Named producers, traceable lots and a direct line to the farm.

why.title: Why we
paragraphs: Colombia grows some of the most admired coffee in the world, yet the families who grow it are often invisible once the coffee leaves the farm. A lot is sold by region and grade, and the people, the farm and the story disappear.

We started in Urrao, Antioquia, because we know the roads and the farms. Our goal is simple: connect family farms with the roasters, importers and coffee shops who care where their coffee comes from, and keep every producer's name attached to every lot.
This page is a draft written for the preview. The founding story will be told in the owner's own words.
why.photoAlt: Coffee pickers with harvest baskets on a Colombian hillside

how.title: How we work
how.text: Four principles guide every lot we list.

items.title: Named, always
items.text: Each lot shows the producer, farm and town. Producers keep their own name and story.

items.title: Verified in steps
items.text: A lot can be Registered, Farm verified or Coffee verified, and we say which.

items.title: Taste before you buy
items.text: Buyers can request a sample of any lot before placing an order.

items.title: Two lines, never mixed
items.text: Green coffee for roasters worldwide, and roasted bags made by the producers for homes in Colombia.
